name: OpenMultiMaps
blurb: OpenMultiMaps is an application that allows to display maps from OpenStreetMap and to quickly switch from a map to another one.
description:
OpenMultiMaps is an application that allows to display maps from OpenStreetMap and to quickly switch from a map to another one.

Maps are grouped in categories:
- Trips
- Life-skills
- Hobbies
- Regional maps
- Contributions

Each of these categories contain several maps allowing to use the current location.
